title: What Quality Engineers Need to Know About Generative AI: Structured Data Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.30778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this expository paper, we explain how quality engineers can use large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for structured data extraction. We introduce the relevant concepts, discuss structured extraction from a measurement-system perspective, and demonstrate its implementation in R and Python. We then present two freely available web-based applications (apps): (a) extracting information from automotive recall notices and (b) monitoring quality engineering research on arXiv. To ensure the accuracy of our AI-driven structured extraction, human evaluators validated the results. In the first app, four reviewers assessed information extracted from 30 recall notices using two models, with 98.6% of the 720 field-level ratings judged fully correct. translated_title: 质量工程师需要了解的生成式人工智能：结构化数据提取
translated_abstract: 在这篇阐述性论文中，我们解释了质量工程师如何使用大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行结构化数据提取。我们介绍了相关概念，从测量系统的视角讨论了结构化提取，并演示了其在 R 和 Python 中的实现。随后我们展示了两个免费开放的基于网络的应用程序：(a) 从汽车召回通知中提取信息；(b) 监测 arXiv 上的质量工程研究。为确保 AI 驱动的结构化提取的准确性，我们由人工评估者对结果进行了验证。在第一个应用中，四名评审员使用两个模型评估了从 30 份召回通知中提取的信息，720 个字段级评分中有 98.6% 被判定为完全正确。在第二个应用中，21 位作者评估了从他们 45 篇 arXiv 论文中提取的信息，所有论文摘要均被评为大部分正确或完全正确，尽管评估（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文向质量工程师介绍了如何利用大语言模型和视觉-语言模型进行结构化数据提取，并提供了两个经人工验证、字段级准确率高达98.6%的免费Web应用（汽车召回通知信息提取与arXiv质量工程研究监测）。
en_tdlr: This paper explains how quality engineers can use LLMs and VLMs for structured data extraction, presenting two free human-validated web apps—automotive recall notice extraction and arXiv quality engineering research monitoring—achieving 98.6% field-level accuracy.
